## Architecture Guidance: root (architecture.md)

# RadiProtocol — Obsidian Plugin for Interactive Protocols

## Project Map
- `src/main.ts` — Plugin entry (`onload`/`onunload`), wires all services and views
- `src/settings.ts` — Settings tab singleton
- `src/protocol/` — Protocol document model, parser, vault store, remote library
- `src/runner/` — Pure traversal state machine + render sub-modules
- `src/graph/` — Directed-graph types, validator, label utilities
- `src/snippets/` — Snippet data model, vault CRUD, external library
- `src/views/` — Obsidian ItemViews, Modals, and reusable DOM widgets
- `src/i18n/` — Translator service (en/ru)
- `src/utils/` — DOM helpers, vault utils, write mutex
- `src/constants/` — CSS classes, runner status enums
- `src/__tests__/` — Test suites mirroring source structure

## Architecture
Feature-grouped modular Obsidian plugin (TypeScript, esbuild, Vitest). Domain logic in `protocol/`, `runner/`, `graph/`, `snippets/` — UI in `views/`. Dependency direction: `views/` → all lower layers; lower layers never import from `views/` (one documented exception: `runner/render/render-snippet-picker.ts` imports `SnippetTreePicker`).

```
views/  → [protocol/ runner/ graph/ snippets/ utils/ i18n/ constants/]
              ↑ (no reverse dependency)
```

## Commands
| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| `npm run dev` | Type-check + esbuild dev bundle |
| `npm run build` | Type-check + esbuild production bundle |
| `npm test` | Run all tests via Vitest |
| `npm run lint` | ESLint + Stylelint |
| `npm run knip` | Dead file detection |

<important if="you are adding a new feature that touches multiple layers">
## Adding a Cross-Layer Feature
1. **Define domain types** in `graph/graph-model.ts` — see `.rpiv/guidance/src/graph/architecture.md`
2. **Add parser support** in `protocol/protocol-document-parser.ts` — see `.rpiv/guidance/src/protocol/architecture.md`
3. **Add validation** in `graph/graph-validator.ts` — see `.rpiv/guidance/src/graph/architecture.md`
4. **Wire runner state** in `runner/protocol-runner.ts` and `runner/runner-state.ts` — see `.rpiv/guidance/src/runner/architecture.md`
5. **Render the new state** in `runner/render/` — see `.rpiv/guidance/src/runner/render/architecture.md`
6. **Add UI components** in `views/` — see `.rpiv/guidance/src/views/architecture.md`
</important>

<important if="you are writing or modifying tests">
- Vitest test runner — no Jest config needed
- Pure modules (graph, runner core, snippet-model): construct directly, no mocking
- Obsidian-dependent services: use `makeVault()` + `makeApp()` mock factory (see `__tests__/protocol-document-store.test.ts`)
- Render layer tests: `MockEl` class + `vi.fn()` host spies (see `__tests__/runner/render-question.test.ts`)
- Runner tests: construct `ProtocolRunner()` with no arguments, build inline graphs with `new Map<string, RPNode>()`
- Fixture files go in `__tests__/fixtures/` (`.canvas` files for graph scenarios)
- Test naming: `describe('Module — feature')`, `it('describes specific behavior')`
</important>

<important if="you are adding or modifying i18n strings">
- Keys follow `componentName.stringName` namespacing (e.g., `snippetEditor.name`, `protocolRunner.stepBack`)
- Add keys to both `src/i18n/locales/en.json` and `src/i18n/locales/ru.json`
- User-authored content (snippet names, template text) is NEVER wrapped in `t()`
- Pure modules receive `Translator` via constructor defaulting to `defaultT`
- Plugin views inject `this.plugin.i18n.t.bind(this.plugin.i18n)`
</important>

# Slices: Create snippet from selected text (Runner footer + command) and Insert snippet modal UX fixes (jumping, keyboard nav, name-only display)

## Slice 1: Pre-fill snippet editor from selection + standalone create-snippet command
**Scope:** Add the shared `initialTemplate?: string` option to `SnippetEditorOptions` and thread a 4th `initialTemplate: string = ''` parameter through `emptyMdTemplateDraft()` into the constructor create-mode branch, so the chip editor's textarea (`mountChipEditor` reads `draft.template` directly) mounts pre-filled with the supplied text and `handleSave()`'s `draftToSave` spread (`snippet-editor-modal.ts:536-537`) carries it into `SnippetService.save()` untouched. Then add a standalone `create-snippet` command in `main.ts` mirroring `handleInsertSnippet()` (`main.ts:96-100`): read the active `MarkdownView` via `getActiveViewOfType`, pre-fill `initialTemplate` from `editor.getSelection()` (empty when no selection or no active md view), construct `new SnippetEditorModal(app, this, { mode: 'create', initialFolder: this.settings.snippetFolderPath, initialTemplate })`, `open()`, await `modal.result`, show a `Notice` on save. Existing create-mode caller `SnippetManagerView.openCreateModal()` compiles unchanged because the new field is optional.
**Draws on:** `src/views/snippet-editor-modal.ts:30-48` (SnippetEditorOptions, no initialTemplate field), `src/views/snippet-editor-modal.ts:71-83` (emptyMdTemplateDraft factory hard-coding `template: ''`), `src/views/snippet-editor-modal.ts:129-137` (constructor create-mode branch calling the factory), `src/views/snippet-editor-modal.ts:384` (mountChipEditor call site — the create-mode chip editor mounts from `templateDraft` which carries `draft.template`), `src/views/snippet-editor-modal.ts:536-537` (md-template draftToSave spread), `src/views/snippet-editor-modal.ts:553` (create-mode safeResolve), `src/views/snippet-chip-editor.ts:125` (`templateArea.value = draft.template` — the textarea pre-fill path the whole outcome rests on), `src/views/snippet-manager-view.ts:258-267` (openCreateModal reference caller pattern), `src/main.ts:96-100` (addCommand registration block), `src/main.ts:285-297` (handleInsertSnippet body — the pattern to mirror: activeFile guard, `new InsertSnippetModal(app, this)`, `modal.open()`, `await modal.result`, then `getActiveViewOfType(MarkdownView)` + `editor` access; create-snippet replaces `editor.replaceSelection` with `editor.getSelection()` for pre-fill)
**Depends on:** none
**Out of scope:** The Runner footer icon and its text-selection detection (Slice 2); all Insert snippet modal UX fixes (Slices 3–5).

## Slice 2: Create snippet from selection in Runner footer
**Scope:** Add an always-visible create-snippet icon button to the `InlineRunnerModal` footer, recreated on every `render()` next to the close button (the footer is torn down and rebuilt each render at `inline-runner-modal.ts:426-434`, so the icon must be re-added in that block — not just in `buildContainer()`). The button is disabled (greyed) until text is selected in `contentEl`, following the icon-button pattern of the Back button at `inline-runner-modal.ts:554-596` (`createButton` + `setIcon` + `addEventListener`). Add a `mouseup`/`selectionchange` listener on `contentEl` (plain div at `inline-runner-modal.ts:325-326`) using `window.getSelection()`/`selection.toString()` to toggle the button's enabled state; follow the existing listener add/remove lifecycle (`boundKeyHandler` added in `open()`, removed in `close()`). On click, open `new SnippetEditorModal(app, this.plugin, { mode: 'create', initialFolder: this.plugin.settings.snippetFolderPath, initialTemplate: selection.toString() })`. `SnippetEditorModal` is a real Obsidian `Modal` mounting to `document.body`, so it stacks above the inline runner overlay — verify stacking in validation (precedent `c0bb3ee`).
**Draws on:** `src/views/inline-runner-modal.ts:301-344` (buildContainer DOM shell + close button), `src/views/inline-runner-modal.ts:325-326` (contentEl plain div, selection source), `src/views/inline-runner-modal.ts:426-434` (render footer teardown + close-button recreation), `src/views/inline-runner-modal.ts:554-596` (renderFooterIcons icon-button pattern), `src/views/inline-runner-modal.ts:226-227` (open() — `this.boundKeyHandler = (e) => this.handleKeydown(e); containerEl.addEventListener('keydown', this.boundKeyHandler)`; the add-listener lifecycle to mirror for the selection listener), `src/views/inline-runner-modal.ts:251-254` (close() — `containerEl.removeEventListener('keydown', this.boundKeyHandler)` + null-out; the remove-listener lifecycle to mirror), `src/views/inline-runner-modal.ts:672-695` (handleKeydown bails for INPUT/TEXTAREA — no conflict), `src/views/snippet-editor-modal.ts:30-48` (initialTemplate option added in Slice 1), `src/views/snippet-manager-view.ts:258-267` (openCreateModal await-result pattern)
**Depends on:** Slice 1 (needs the `initialTemplate` option on `SnippetEditorOptions` to pre-fill the editor)
**Out of scope:** The standalone command and the `initialTemplate` option itself (Slice 1); Insert snippet modal UX fixes (Slices 3–5).

## Slice 3: Insert snippet modal pinning — no jumping on keystroke
**Scope:** Stop `InsertSnippetModal` (extends Obsidian `Modal`, auto-centers vertically on content-height change) from recentering on every keystroke. Add `modalEl.addClass('rp-insert-snippet-modal')` in `onOpen()` following the `SnippetEditorModal` CSS-scoping pattern (`snippet-editor-modal.ts:151-153` casts to access protected `modalEl`). Add scoped CSS overriding Obsidian's vertical centering (pin near top: `margin-top`/`top: 0; bottom: auto`) and stabilize the body height so the `renderSearchResults()` removal+rebuild (`removeBody(host)` then bare `.rp-stp-list` recreated directly on `host`, not wrapped in `.rp-stp-body`) does not change outer dimensions. The insert host `.rp-insert-snippet-picker-host` currently gets only width CSS (`snippet-tree-picker.css:222-228`) — no height treatment — unlike `.rp-stp-modal-host .rp-stp-body { height: 360px }` (`:27`) and `.rp-stp-modal-host .rp-stp-list { min-height: 240px }` (`:249-250`) which apply only to the Snippet Manager move-to modal. The async-gap blank-jump was already fixed by `fed8242`; this slice addresses the remaining height-recentering symptom via CSS only.
**Draws on:** `src/views/insert-snippet-modal.ts:8` (InsertSnippetModal extends Modal), `src/views/insert-snippet-modal.ts:21-43` (onOpen creates .rp-insert-snippet-picker-host, mounts SnippetTreePicker file-only), `src/views/snippet-editor-modal.ts:151-153` (modalEl.addClass CSS-scoping pattern), `src/views/snippet-tree-picker.ts:316` (removeBody — keeps only `.rp-stp-search`, tears down every other child of `host`; the rebuild the height-stabilization must survive), `src/views/snippet-tree-picker.ts:416-473` (renderSearchResults — `removeBody(host)` then bare `.rp-stp-list` recreated directly on `host`, not wrapped in `.rp-stp-body`; the structure whose outer dimensions the CSS must pin), `src/styles/snippet-tree-picker.css:14-23` (.rp-stp-body min-height: 280px — drill view only), `src/styles/snippet-tree-picker.css:27` (.rp-stp-modal-host .rp-stp-body height: 360px — not applied to insert host), `src/styles/snippet-tree-picker.css:148` (.rp-stp-list max-height: 320px, no min-height in insert context), `src/styles/snippet-tree-picker.css:222-228` (.rp-insert-snippet-picker-host width-only, no height), `src/styles/snippet-tree-picker.css:249-250` (.rp-stp-modal-host .rp-stp-list min-height: 240px — not applied to insert host)
**Depends on:** none
**Out of scope:** Keyboard navigation (Slice 4) and name-only display (Slice 5); the create-from-selection flows (Slices 1–2).

## Slice 4: SnippetTreePicker keyboard navigation (ArrowUp/Down + Enter)
**Scope:** Implement keyboard navigation inside `SnippetTreePicker` itself so every consumer (Insert snippet modal + Runner snippet-pick at `render-snippet-picker.ts:90`) gets it for free. Add a `highlightedIndex`/`highlightedRowEl` field, a `keydown` listener on the search input handling `ArrowUp`/`ArrowDown` (move highlight, `row.scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest' })`) and `Enter` (dispatch the highlighted row's `onSelect` callback, flowing through the identical load/guard/close path both consumers already wire), a `.rp-stp-row-highlighted` class, and reset the highlight on every re-render (old DOM removed via `removeBody`). Broaden `removeListenersExceptSearch()` to also preserve `entry.type === 'keydown'` on `searchInputEl`, or the new listener is silently dropped on the first search re-render. Add new i18n keys (e.g. highlight aria-label) to **both** `src/i18n/locales/en.json` and `src/i18n/locales/ru.json`. `InlineRunnerModal.handleKeydown()` bails for `INPUT`/`TEXTAREA` targets (`inline-runner-modal.ts:672-695`), so arrow keys in the picker's search box won't be consumed by the runner.
**Draws on:** `src/views/snippet-tree-picker.ts:62-72` (SnippetTreePickerOptions), `src/views/snippet-tree-picker.ts:108-138` (mount() — builds `.rp-stp-root`, the search input row, and calls `renderDrillView`; the keydown listener must be added inside this method), `src/views/snippet-tree-picker.ts:130` (`addListener(searchInput, 'input', ...)` — the existing input listener the new keydown listener sits alongside, establishing the addListener convention), `src/views/snippet-tree-picker.ts:168` (removeListenersExceptSearch keeps only search-input input — broaden to preserve 'keydown'), `src/views/snippet-tree-picker.ts:377-380` (renderFileRow path-div gate — shared cite with Slice 5 is fine), `src/runner/render/render-snippet-picker.ts:90` (Runner snippet-pick consumer, gets keyboard nav for free), `src/views/inline-runner-modal.ts:672-695` (handleKeydown bails for INPUT/TEXTAREA — no conflict), `src/i18n/locales/en.json` (snippetTreePicker namespace, add keys to both en + ru)
**Depends on:** none
**Out of scope:** Name-only display / hideSearchResultPath (Slice 5); modal pinning/geometry (Slice 3); the create-from-selection flows (Slices 1–2).

## Slice 5: SnippetTreePicker name-only display via hideSearchResultPath
**Scope:** Add a `hideSearchResultPath?: boolean` option flag to `SnippetTreePickerOptions` (default `false`); the path-div guard in `renderFileRow()` (`snippet-tree-picker.ts:377-380`) becomes `if (isSearchResult && !this.options.hideSearchResultPath)`. Pass `hideSearchResultPath: true` from `InsertSnippetModal.onOpen()` only — preserves disambiguation in Snippet Manager move-to where same-named snippets in different folders need the path. This is a display rule only, orthogonal to keyboard navigation; it touches the same `renderFileRow` path-div gate that Slice 4 cites but does not alter the highlight/keydown mechanics, so the two slices compose without coupling.
**Draws on:** `src/views/snippet-tree-picker.ts:62-72` (SnippetTreePickerOptions, no hideSearchResultPath field), `src/views/snippet-tree-picker.ts:377-380` (renderFileRow path-div gate, gated by isSearchResult), `src/views/insert-snippet-modal.ts:21-43` (onOpen mounts SnippetTreePicker file-only — add hideSearchResultPath: true here)
**Depends on:** none
**Out of scope:** Keyboard navigation (Slice 4); modal pinning/geometry (Slice 3); the create-from-selection flows (Slices 1–2).

# RadiProtocol — Obsidian Plugin for Interactive Protocols

## Project Map
- `src/main.ts` — Plugin entry (`onload`/`onunload`), wires all services and views
- `src/settings.ts` — Settings tab singleton
- `src/protocol/` — Protocol document model, parser, vault store, remote library
- `src/runner/` — Pure traversal state machine + render sub-modules
- `src/graph/` — Directed-graph types, validator, label utilities
- `src/snippets/` — Snippet data model, vault CRUD, external library
- `src/views/` — Obsidian ItemViews, Modals, and reusable DOM widgets
- `src/i18n/` — Translator service (en/ru)
- `src/utils/` — DOM helpers, vault utils, write mutex
- `src/constants/` — CSS classes, runner status enums
- `src/__tests__/` — Test suites mirroring source structure

## Architecture
Feature-grouped modular Obsidian plugin (TypeScript, esbuild, Vitest). Domain logic in `protocol/`, `runner/`, `graph/`, `snippets/` — UI in `views/`. Dependency direction: `views/` → all lower layers; lower layers never import from `views/` (one documented exception: `runner/render/render-snippet-picker.ts` imports `SnippetTreePicker`).

```
views/  → [protocol/ runner/ graph/ snippets/ utils/ i18n/ constants/]
              ↑ (no reverse dependency)
```

| `npm run dev` | Type-check + esbuild dev bundle |
| `npm run build` | Type-check + esbuild production bundle |
| `npm test` | Run all tests via Vitest |
| `npm run lint` | ESLint + Stylelint |
| `npm run knip` | Dead file detection |

# Design — Slice 3: Insert snippet modal pinning — no jumping on keystroke

## Approach

`InsertSnippetModal extends Modal` (`src/views/insert-snippet-modal.ts:8`). Obsidian's
`Modal` base vertically centers `.modal` inside `.modal-container` (flex,
`align-items: center`). Because the picker rebuilds its body on every debounced
keystroke — `renderSearchResults()` calls `removeBody(host)` then recreates a **bare**
`.rp-stp-list` directly on `host` (not wrapped in `.rp-stp-body`,
`src/views/snippet-tree-picker.ts:416-473`) — the modal's content height changes per
keystroke, so Obsidian re-centers and the modal visibly jumps. The async-gap
blank-jump was already fixed by `fed8242`; the remaining symptom is purely the
height-recentering on result-count change.

The fix is **CSS-only** plus a single `addClass` call — no JS logic change in the
picker. Two parts, both scoped to a new `rp-insert-snippet-modal` class added to
`modalEl` in `onOpen()`:

1. **Pin the modal near the top.** Add `rp-insert-snippet-modal` to `modalEl`
   (using the protected-cast pattern from `snippet-editor-modal.ts:151-153`, since
   `modalEl` is protected on `Modal`). A scoped `.rp-insert-snippet-modal { align-self:
   flex-start; margin-top: 0; }` opts out of the container's `align-items: center`, so
   content-height changes no longer recenter. The container's top padding still gives
   a sensible near-top offset.

2. **Stabilize the picker body height in the insert host.** The insert host
   `.rp-insert-snippet-picker-host` currently gets only width CSS
   (`snippet-tree-picker.css:222-228`) — no height treatment — unlike
   `.rp-stp-modal-host .rp-stp-body { height: 360px }` (`:26`) and
   `.rp-stp-modal-host .rp-stp-list { min-height: 240px }` (`:249-250`) which apply only
   to the Snippet Manager move-to modal. Add the same height treatment scoped to the
   insert host so the rebuild never changes outer dimensions:
   - `.rp-insert-snippet-picker-host .rp-stp-root > .rp-stp-body { height: 360px }` —
     stabilizes the drill view (breadcrumb + list).
   - `.rp-insert-snippet-picker-host .rp-stp-root > .rp-stp-list { min-height: 320px }`
     — stabilizes the bare search-result list. The global `.rp-stp-list { max-height:
     320px }` (`:148`) still applies, so `min-height == max-height == 320px` fixes the
     search list at exactly 320px regardless of result count. The `> .rp-stp-list`
     direct-child selector avoids touching the inner list inside `.rp-stp-body` (which
     is governed by `.rp-stp-body .rp-stp-list { flex: 1 1 auto }`, `:40`).

This is intentionally CSS-only: it composes with Slice 4 (keyboard nav) and Slice 5
(name-only display) without coupling — both touch `snippet-tree-picker.ts` rendering,
not the modal geometry or host CSS.

## File Map

- `src/views/insert-snippet-modal.ts` — change — at the top of `onOpen()`, add
  `modalEl.addClass('rp-insert-snippet-modal')` via the same protected-cast pattern
  used by `SnippetEditorModal` (`snippet-editor-modal.ts:151-153`). No other JS
  change.
- `src/styles/snippet-tree-picker.css` — change — append scoped rules next to the
  existing `.rp-insert-snippet-picker-host` width-only block (`:222-228`): a
  `.rp-insert-snippet-modal` pin rule (`align-self: flex-start; margin-top: 0`) and
  two height-stabilization rules for `.rp-insert-snippet-picker-host .rp-stp-root >
  .rp-stp-body` (`height: 360px`) and `.rp-insert-snippet-picker-host .rp-stp-root >
  .rp-stp-list` (`min-height: 320px`). No new CSS file — `snippet-tree-picker.css` is
  already in `CSS_FILES` in `esbuild.config.mjs:46-56`.

## Key Interfaces

No new types or exports. The only new contract is the CSS class name
`rp-insert-snippet-modal` applied to the Obsidian `Modal.modalEl` by
`InsertSnippetModal.onOpen()`. Slice 4 and Slice 5 do not consume it.

```ts
// src/views/insert-snippet-modal.ts — onOpen() preamble (shape, not full body)
onOpen(): void {
  // Slice 3: scope modal geometry so search-result rebuilds don't recenter.
  const modalEl = (this as unknown as { modalEl?: { addClass?: (cls: string) => void } }).modalEl;
  if (typeof modalEl?.addClass === 'function') {
    modalEl.addClass('rp-insert-snippet-modal');
  }
  const { contentEl, titleEl } = this;
  // …existing body unchanged…
}
```

```css
/* src/styles/snippet-tree-picker.css — appended after the .rp-insert-snippet-picker-host
   width-only rule (lines 222-228). */
/* Slice 3 — Pin insert-snippet modal near the top + stabilize body height so the
   search-result rebuild (removeBody + bare .rp-stp-list on host) doesn't recenter
   the modal on every keystroke. The insert host previously had only width CSS. */
.rp-insert-snippet-modal {
  /* Opt out of .modal-container's align-items: center; anchor to top padding. */
  align-self: flex-start;
  margin-top: 0;
}

.rp-insert-snippet-picker-host .rp-stp-root > .rp-stp-body {
  /* Stabilize drill view outer height (matches .rp-stp-modal-host treatment). */
  height: 360px;
}

.rp-insert-snippet-picker-host .rp-stp-root > .rp-stp-list {
  /* Bare search-result list recreated on host by renderSearchResults().
     Global .rp-stp-list { max-height: 320px } (line 148) still applies, so
     min==max==320px fixes the height regardless of result count. */
  min-height: 320px;
}
```

## Integration Points

- `src/views/insert-snippet-modal.ts:21` — `modalEl.addClass('rp-insert-snippet-modal')`
  inserted as the first statement of `onOpen()`, before `contentEl.empty()`. Mirrors
  the protected-cast pattern at `src/views/snippet-editor-modal.ts:151-153`.
- `src/styles/snippet-tree-picker.css:222-228` — the new `.rp-insert-snippet-modal`,
  `.rp-insert-snippet-picker-host .rp-stp-root > .rp-stp-body`, and
  `.rp-insert-snippet-picker-host .rp-stp-root > .rp-stp-list` rules are appended
  immediately after the existing `.rp-insert-snippet-picker-host` width-only block,
  extending the same host scope. `snippet-tree-picker.css` is already wired into the
  build via `esbuild.config.mjs` `CSS_FILES`.
- No coupling to Slices 1–2 (create-from-selection flows) or Slices 4–5 (picker render
  changes): those touch `snippet-tree-picker.ts` / `main.ts` / `snippet-editor-modal.ts`,
  not the insert modal's `modalEl` class or the insert-host height CSS.

## Success Criteria

- [ ] `InsertSnippetModal.onOpen()` adds class `rp-insert-snippet-modal` to `modalEl`
      using the protected-cast pattern (mirrors `snippet-editor-modal.ts:151-153`).
- [ ] `snippet-tree-picker.css` defines `.rp-insert-snippet-modal` with
      `align-self: flex-start` and `margin-top: 0` (opts out of Obsidian's flex
      vertical centering).
- [ ] `snippet-tree-picker.css` sets `.rp-insert-snippet-picker-host .rp-stp-root >
      .rp-stp-body { height: 360px }` (stabilizes the drill view).
- [ ] `snippet-tree-picker.css` sets `.rp-insert-snippet-picker-host .rp-stp-root >
      .rp-stp-list { min-height: 320px }` (stabilizes the bare search-result list;
      combined with the global `max-height: 320px` at `:148`, the height is fixed).
- [ ] The inner list inside `.rp-stp-body` (drill view) is **not** affected by the new
      `min-height` rule — direct-child selector `> .rp-stp-list` targets only the bare
      search list (verified by reading the CSS).
- [ ] Manual: open Insert snippet, type a query that matches a varying number of
      snippets, then clear it — the modal does not move vertically on any keystroke.
- [ ] `npm run lint` (ESLint + Stylelint) passes on the changed files.
- [ ] `npm run build` (type-check + esbuild) passes.

## Notes / Deferred

- **Assumption on Obsidian centering.** The pin rule assumes Obsidian centers `.modal`
  via flex `align-items: center` on `.modal-container` (current behavior); `align-self:
  flex-start` opts out. If a future Obsidian version switches `.modal` to
  absolute/fixed positioning, the pin would need `top: 0; bottom: auto` instead. This
  is a runtime/visual concern, deferred to re-validation if Obsidian bumps break the
  pin — not a blocker for this slice.
- **`fed8242` already fixed the async-gap blank-jump.** This slice does **not** touch
  `renderSearchResults()` JS (`snippet-tree-picker.ts:416-473`) — the "keep the current
  rendered body in place while the async vault scan runs" guard there stays intact.
  Slice 3 only addresses the remaining height-recentering symptom, via CSS + the
  `addClass` call.
- **No i18n strings.** The slice adds no user-visible text, so no keys are added to
  `src/i18n/locales/en.json` or `ru.json`.
- **Orthogonal to Slices 4 & 5.** Keyboard navigation (Slice 4) and name-only display
  (Slice 5) both modify `snippet-tree-picker.ts` rendering (`renderFileRow`, listeners)
  — they do not touch the insert modal's `modalEl` class or the insert-host height CSS,
  so the three slices compose without coupling.
